resolution_law.scope: kind authority release namespace exact local content identity and version
resolution_law.present: an endpoint has an exact matching present declaration in the selected batch
resolution_law.retired: an endpoint has an exact matching retired declaration and no present declaration in the selected batch
resolution_law.unresolved: an endpoint has no matching declaration in the selected batch
resolution_law.conflict: one scoped coordinate cannot be both present and retired in the same selected batch
resolution_law.content_boundary: the local identifier is the canonical content identity of the exact field value; the scoped Highway coordinate is not content identity
resolution_law.ordering: output preserves exact input occurrence order while receipt identity binds the whole ordered batch
